source.adaptation_notice: Plain rolled-oat and dairy-milk base adapted from the pinned Wikibooks source; optional toppings, alternative grains and milk substitutions are excluded. Exact published quantities45g rolled oats,180ml water and180ml dairy milk yield one counted source serving. One each means one complete source-serving output; cooked mass and volume are unknown. Adult Regular counts exactly one unscaled source serving as an operational convention, not nutritional adequacy, age advice or human-calibrated portion size. Fresh preparation for one unrestricted adult at-home breakfast only. Reserve15minutes of full attention as an unmeasured estimate based on the source time header; the published method specifies a5minute simmer. No gluten-free, dairy-free, child, Smaller/Larger, nutrition, image, storage, portable, extra-portion, leftover or reuse qualification is supplied. Raw dairy milk form means liquid recipe input, not unpasteurised milk. Adapted text is licensed CC-BY-SA-4.0 with source attribution.

steps.text: Put the rolled oats and water in a pot, cover with a lid and bring to the boil. Stir when bubbling, lower the heat to maintain a simmer, replace the lid and watch for overflow. Stir about every minute. After the source's five-minute simmer, remove the lid, stir well, add the dairy milk and keep stirring until mixed. Serve the plain porridge after preparation; optional toppings are outside this packet. Reserve15minutes of full attention as an estimate, not a measured cooking guarantee.
